title: Prompt Engineering Mastery
subtitle: The Complete Beginner-to-Advanced Guide to Getting Better Results from AI Chatbots, Coding Assistants, Image Generators, and Agents
cover_tagline: The Complete Guide to Getting Better Results from AI Chatbots, Image Tools, and Agents
author: Aadhavan Muthurengan
back_cover_blurb: Get better results from AI, every time.
Most people type a question into an AI assistant, get a generic answer, and give up. The difference between a mediocre answer and a brilliant one is almost never the model. It is the prompt.
Prompt Engineering Mastery takes you step by step from your very first prompt to the techniques professionals use to build AI products and agents. No technical background required.
- The six-part blueprint for writing any prompt
- How to prompt the leading AI chatbots and open models
- Prompting for coding assistants and AI image, video, and music tools
- Playbooks for doctors, engineers, sales, parents, lawyers, musicians, and more
- System prompts, RAG, tool use, and custom agent design
- Connecting AI to your browser, files, and apps with MCP
- How to test prompts and defend against prompt injection
